Title: Intermezzo
Author: Sally Rooney
My Review:
A book about the relationship of two brothers while grieving their father’s death. And, of course, about how they navigate romantic relationships (it’s Sally Rooney, what else could we expect?).

Maybe the book touched me in a special way because I recently saw a person very close to me lose their father and was trying to understand their feelings through the characters (and trying to put myself in their position).

A very well written and touching book. My favorite one from the author so far.
